text.2:50: And when We brought you through the sea and rescued you, and drowned the folk of Pharaoh in your sight.
text.5:25: He said: My Lord! I have control of none but myself and my brother, so distinguish between us and the wrong-doing folk.
text.17:106: And (it is) a Qur'an that We have divided, that thou mayst recite it unto mankind at intervals, and We have revealed it by (successive) revelation.
text.44:4: Whereon every wise command is made clear
